title: AI Data Sources: Answers From Your Site's Content | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
The content of your own site, such as help articles, products or news, can be knowledge for an AI assistant. A CrestApps AI data source turns a content index into a knowledge base, keeps it in step as the content changes, and lets an assistant answer from it, with numbered sources.

In this video:
• Why large and changing content needs a data source instead of uploads
• How the source index, the knowledge base index and the data source fit together
• Indexing your content, and creating the AI Knowledge Base index
• Creating a Search Index Profile data source and its field mapping
• Syncing the data source
• Choosing the data source on a profile: Filter, Restrict answers to retrieved data only, Strictness and Retrieved documents
• An answer with its sources, and the site-wide defaults

chapters.title: Give the assistant the data source
